scope: Independent offline analysis of parent-executed identity MRR under initialized Linux
observed_channel0_data_lane: raw bits15:8; all other bits zero in these samples
observed_channel1_data_lane: raw bits7:0; all other bits zero in these samples

interpretation.revision: MR6=0x07 is vendor-specific revision ID1=7; exact part/generation not identified
interpretation.mr8: 0x18: S16/16n prefetch, x16/channel, 16Gibits per channel (32Gibits for a dual-channel die)

capacity_if_existing_topology_is_correct.caution: Conditional consistency with existing topology, not an independent rank-routing/capacity test

freshness_assessment.basis: Three distinct correct MR values follow both forward and reversed request order for every requested channel/rank.
excludes: one invariant stale latch throughout the run
a simple one-transaction-old response across these differing MR requests
does_not_establish: receive-valid/error/clear bit semantics or freshness for arbitrary requests
distinct physical rank routing: both ranks report identical IDs
independent physical channel routing: both channels report identical IDs
memory alias-free capacity, training quality, or cold initialization

sources.title: Micron z19m_embedded_lpddr4_lpddr4x.pdf Rev.G 04/2022
sources.facts_used: MR5 ff=Micron; MR6 is vendor-specific; MR8 type00=S16, width00=x16/channel, density0110=16Gb/channel or32Gb/dual-channel die.
Independent public LP4 readout recognizes ff=Micron, width code0=x16/code1=x8 and density code6=32Gb per dual-channel die.
